name: pad
description: Personal Assistant Dashboard — dev orchestrator for the Go backend + React/Vite frontend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend
scripts.check:backend: go -C backend build ./... && go -C backend vet ./...
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test
